text.tspan: Outer setup differs by subcommand. The per-XR body is identical.

For each affected XR, CDP calls DP.DiffSingleResource with a provider that returns the proposed composition, and the predicted revision name for a composite that would re-point. See per-XR body below.
PerformDiff iterates the input resources, calling DiffSingleResource on each. See per-XR body below.
per-XR body. DiffSingleResource(ctx, xr, compositionProvider). Driven once per input XR (xr) or once per affected XR (comp).

Effective = input + cluster's compositionRef / compositionRevisionRef / policy / UID, or a claim's backing XR with the claim synced in. renderXR = strict Defaulter.Default(Effective). authoredXR stays as written: it is the payload.
If a revision was resolved, set renderXR's compositionRevisionRef to it (creating the ref if absent), as the reconciler does before composing.

svg.text: FetchCurrentObject (the XR unless a nested XR copy is supplied, plus a claim backing XR)
cluster copy / backing XR (fetch error is fatal)
ResolvedComposition (cluster's composition and revision, or proposed under comp)
observed composed resources (fetch failure is fatal)
RenderToStableState(ctx, renderXR, comp, fns, id, observed, eventualState)
Recurse via diffSingleResourceInternal with the nested XR's cluster copy (err if depth > --max-nested-depth)
